name: Avgolemono (Greek Lemon Chicken Soup)
desc: Greek chicken and orzo soup thickened with a tempered egg and lemon mixture.

source.title: Avgolemono (Greek lemon chicken soup)
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 5-8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (about 2 to 3 lb)
1 tsp kosher salt, plus more to taste
2 tbsp olive oil, plus more for drizzling
1-2 cups hot broth from the pot
2 tbsp chopped fresh dill or parsley

steps: Pat the chicken dry and season with the salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the thighs skin side down 5-6 min until golden, flip for 2 min, then set aside. Pour off all but about 2 tbsp of fat.
Lower the heat to medium. Cook the onion, celery and carrot 5 min until softened, add the garlic and Italian seasoning, and stir 1 min until fragrant.
Add the broth and bay leaves and return the chicken with its juices. Bring to a boil, then lower to a gentle simmer and cook partly covered 45 min, until the chicken is very tender.
Lift out the chicken. Discard the skin and bones, shred the meat, and return it to the pot. Remove the bay leaves.
Bring the soup back to a simmer, add the orzo, and cook 8-10 min until tender, stirring now and then so it does not stick.
Meanwhile, whisk the eggs in a bowl until smooth, then whisk in the lemon juice and zest.
Turn the soup down to low. While whisking constantly, pour a ladle of hot broth into the eggs in a thin stream. Repeat with 1 or 2 more ladles until the egg mixture feels warm.
Slowly stir the tempered mixture back into the pot. Heat gently 2-3 min, stirring, until the soup thickens slightly. Do not let it boil or the eggs will curdle.
Taste for salt and pepper. Serve garnished with dill or parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.
tips: Tempering (slowly adding hot broth to the eggs) keeps them from scrambling.
Leftover orzo keeps soaking up broth; thin reheated soup with a little broth or water and warm it gently without boiling.
